To use the Neural Amp Modeler for modeling, you must first download some models:
- Audition/Download from:  tone3000.com
- In this UI, Click File Manager (bottom left)
- Click "NAM Models" folder
- Click Upload, select files previously downloaded from tone3000.com
- On pi-Stomp: System Menu > Restart sound engine
- Now you should be able to select the .nam files in the NAM plugin

Many reverbs/delays/IR's, when following NAM, will create a horible burst of noise when the pedalboard is first loaded.

The cause is NaN (not a number) output from NAM.  A reverb/delay with feedback can recycle this bad output creating a nasty digital cacophony.

A few reverbs seem to be NaN-safe including: DISTRHO DIE Reverb, and the X42
